organization_invitations_lifecycle_check.name: organization_invitations_lifecycle_check
organization_invitations_lifecycle_check.value:
("organization_invitations"."status" = 'pending' AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
                OR ("organization_invitations"."status" = 'accepted' AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_invitations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
                OR ("organization_invitations"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

organization_memberships_lifecycle_check.name: organization_memberships_lifecycle_check
organization_memberships_lifecycle_check.value:
("organization_memberships"."status" = 'active' AND "organization_memberships"."suspended_at" IS NULL AND "organization_memberships"."removed_at" IS NULL)
                OR ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'suspended' AND "organization_memberships"."suspended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_memberships"."removed_at" IS NULL)
                OR ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'removed' AND "organization_memberships"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)

audit_events_actor_check.name: audit_events_actor_check
audit_events_actor_check.value:
("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'system' AND "audit_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)
                OR ("audit_events"."actor_type" IN ('user', 'administrator') AND "audit_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

parties_archive_state.name: parties_archive_state
parties_archive_state.value: ("parties"."status" = 'active' AND "parties"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("parties"."status" = 'archived' AND "parties"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

asset_identifiers_retired_state.name: asset_identifiers_retired_state
asset_identifiers_retired_state.value: ("asset_identifiers"."status" = 'active' AND "asset_identifiers"."retired_at" IS NULL) OR ("asset_identifiers"."status" = 'retired' AND "asset_identifiers"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL)

assets_archive_state.name: assets_archive_state
assets_archive_state.value: ("assets"."status" = 'active' AND "assets"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("assets"."status" = 'archived' AND "assets"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
